scope: Required actual-native private color-probe cases; no installed pass or full Card acceptance

rows.name: standard-rgba
rows.setup: Mount a fresh matching producer with the private color observer enabled; keep the editor owner value empty.
rows.action: Activate Sample standard colors once.
rows.expected: One query result reports actual owner/target/window/epoch/revision, red RGBA1/0/0/1 and blue0/0/1 with alpha77/255 within1e-6; the root surface, editor value/selection/ref and request count remain unchanged.

rows.name: opaque-platform
rows.setup: Use UIKit labelColor or Android themed textColorPrimary and the native default appearance.
rows.action: Activate Sample native opaque colors once.
rows.expected: Both colors resolve through the actual owned view environment; native target/context IDs and finite normalized components are recorded. Compare with the same native SDK semantic/resource value and keep the root/editor unchanged.

rows.name: live-appearance
rows.setup: Retain the owner/ref/query count after case002.
rows.action: Change the actual system light/dark appearance while the scene remains mounted, then sample the same opaque endpoints.
rows.expected: A current native environment revision accompanies the new result; iOS dynamic color red/blue follows actual light/dark traits, with no old-context result accepted or editor mutation.

rows.name: native-contrast
rows.setup: Retain the iOS owner and native dynamic color fixture.
rows.action: Change actual native high contrast and sample opaque colors again.
rows.expected: Dynamic native endpoints resolve to green for high-contrast light or yellow for high-contrast dark; native environment revision and actual native accessibility setting are recorded.
rows.reason: This fixture uses UIKit DynamicColorIOS high-contrast endpoints; Android themed native resources remain required by002/003.

rows.name: owner-retirement
rows.setup: Mount a current owner and ensure no query is pending.
rows.action: Activate Query then retire actual owner.
rows.expected: The actual root/editor refs retire; the old query rejects without a result, color fallback, extra editor request, stale style write or fake acknowledgment.

rows.name: owner-replacement
rows.setup: Retire the owner from005 and retain the old query record.
rows.action: Restore actual owner and sample again.
rows.expected: The new actual native owner/ref/request nonce produces a fresh result; delayed records from005 cannot complete or cancel this query.

rows.name: window-scope
rows.setup: Freeze actual target/owner/window/epoch IDs in an authorized separate native-window fixture.
rows.action: Move the retained query owner between supported native windows and query again.
rows.expected: Actual native window/scope/epoch/context revisions change; stale owner/window requests reject and cannot affect the new current query or editor.

rows.name: invalid-native-color
rows.setup: Use an acceptance-only invalid native platform color identifier while retaining the authored static root color.
rows.action: Request one batch containing that unresolved endpoint.
rows.expected: The native query reports unresolved-native-color and rejects the entire batch; no zero/black/static fallback or partial accepted result is emitted.

rows.name: wide-gamut
rows.setup: Use an acceptance-only native display-p3 endpoint while retaining its authored static ColorValue.
rows.action: Request interpolation sampling of that endpoint.
rows.expected: The sRGB kernel sampling path rejects unsupported-native-color-space explicitly and leaves the original static color untouched; no implicit gamut clipping or snap is accepted.

rows.name: focused-editor
rows.setup: Freshly focus the held-empty editor and retain original native refs/method identities.
rows.action: Enter an unpaced correction while declining owner changes, then activate a color sample without finishing editing.
rows.expected: Record native field/change/selection, exact requested count and held owner separately; color sampling causes no text/selection/focus write or extra request. Original RN-TEXT-01/ComboBox failures remain independent and unresolved.

rows.name: rotation
rows.setup: Start with actual opaque color result, owner/ref and request count in portrait.
rows.action: Rotate landscape then portrait and sample opaque endpoints after each native environment change.
rows.expected: The running scene retains owner/editor state and request counts; each accepted batch belongs to the current actual native window/environment. Required controls and records remain reachable inside measured safe/keyboard bounds.

rows.name: probe-controls-and-records
rows.setup: Mount the private probe with long English/French records and a held empty editor under the actual required font/orientation profile.
rows.action: Scroll to the real end and activate the final reachable query/owner control.
rows.expected: Record actual frames/font scale/safe/keyboard bounds; controls and records are reachable with owner/ref/query/editor state preserved. This private probe never replaces the complete Card adaptive/layout/motion grid.

profileRationale: Pure normalized RGBA/request-identity cases use normal portrait because their arithmetic and identity checks do not depend on font scaling; native opaque appearance/contrast and rotation are explicit cases. Probe reachability repeats profiles3.3.1–3.3.6; all complete Card3.3.1–3.3.8 motion/layout/constraint obligations remain required.
